description.mn: Afnan Supremacy Not Only Intense: Эрэгтэйчүүдэд зориулсан хув үнэр (Extrait). Эхний ноот: үхрийн нүд, бергамот, алим; зүрхний ноот: царсны хөвд, пачули, лаванда; суурь ноот: амбра, гүргэм, заар.
description.en: Supremacy Not Only Intense by Afnan Perfumes is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Supremacy Not Only Intense was launched in 2021. Top notes are Black Currant, Bergamot and Apple; middle notes are Oakmoss, Patchouli and Lavender; base notes are Ambergris, Saffron and Musk.
